h1: Kitchen Fitting in Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds & Cambridge

intro.html: The kitchen is the heart of every home: a space for cooking, gathering, and making memories. At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we believe your kitchen should be as practical as it is beautiful. That’s why we specialise in kitchen fitting services for homeowners in Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and the surrounding areas.

With over 40 years of combined carpentry and construction experience, our family-run team combines technical skill with creative design. Whether you’re after a sleek modern kitchen, a warm traditional style, or something completely bespoke, we’ll bring your vision to life with care and precision.

chapters.heading: Expert Kitchen Fitting Services Across Cambridgeshire & Suffolk

blocks.html: Our kitchen fitting services cover everything from single upgrades to full kitchen installations. We fit units, replace kitchen doors, install worktops, build islands, and complete full refurbishments. Every element is carefully measured, expertly installed, and finished to the highest standard.

We know that every household has different needs. Some families need maximum storage, while others want open space for entertaining. That’s why we design and fit bespoke kitchens tailored to your lifestyle. From cabinetry and shelving to clever storage solutions, we’ll make sure your new kitchen looks stunning and works perfectly for your day-to-day life.

chapters.heading: Complete Kitchen Fitting from Start to Finish

blocks.html: Our service goes beyond fitting cabinets. We manage the whole process, from removing your old kitchen to completing the final finishing touches. Because we work with a trusted network of plasterers, electricians and other trades, we can coordinate everything for you. This design-to-completion approach means less stress and a smoother experience from start to finish.

chapters.heading: Carpentry & Joinery Expertise for Kitchen Projects

blocks.html: As qualified carpenters, we bring a level of craftsmanship that sets us apart. We can hand-build bespoke units, craft custom kitchen islands, and ensure all joinery is carried out with precision. Whether it’s fitting off-the-shelf units or designing one-of-a-kind cabinetry, our carpentry expertise ensures durability and attention to detail throughout.

chapters.heading: Why Choose Us for Kitchen Fitting

blocks.html: Homeowners across Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and beyond choose us for their kitchen projects because we offer:

Bespoke design and build tailored to your lifestyle
